subject.title: Clarify or update bundled Ollama Cloud MiniMax static default model

question: Should the curated static Ollama Cloud MiniMax fallback advance to M3, retain M2.7, or expose both with M3 preferred?
rationale: The live catalog already exposes M3, but existing history calls the static list curated and does not define whether it should follow the latest generation or prioritize a stable recommendation.

options.title: Prefer M3, retain M2.7
options.body: Add M3 as the preferred static MiniMax entry and keep M2.7 as a secondary supported choice until upstream support or compatibility evidence warrants removal.

options.title: Replace with M3
options.body: Remove M2.7 from the bundled fallback and make M3 the sole static MiniMax recommendation so static and live discovery favor the same generation.

options.title: Keep M2.7
options.body: Preserve the existing curated fallback and document why it intentionally differs from the current live Ollama Cloud catalog.

recommendation.title: Prefer M3, retain M2.7
recommendation.body: Add M3 as the preferred static MiniMax entry and keep M2.7 as a secondary supported choice until upstream support or compatibility evidence warrants removal.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in their curated-cloud-model work and later live-discovery/static-fallback changes.
